newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Gas Oil/Jet-Gas oil down on surplus supplies.
newsitem.headline: Asia Gas Oil/Jet-Gas oil down on surplus supplies.

text.p: Singapore gas oil prices fell late Friday as desperate sellers emerged to get rid of their excess stocks, traders said.
They said prices are poised to fall further unless fresh demand emerges.
Late Friday, ample of offers emerged but sellers were mostly unwilling to move prices lower to meet buyers' levels.
End June to early July cargoes were offered at between $22.95-$23.20 per barrel, having edged downwards fromearlier levels of $23.20-$23.50. A bid was seen at $23.00.
A western trader was heard to be offering a cargo to Hong Kong at 20 cents premium to Singapore spot quotes for July delivery. This compares with the usual premia of over 50 cents.
Free-on-board Singapore cargoes were offered at discount of 20 cents. Late last week, levels were at par to around 10 cents premium.
Traders said the lack of demand and high stocks have prompted refiners to consider cutting runs again.
A major oil firm was heard to be considering cutting runs by 10-percent this weekend but traders at the firm would not confirm the details.

High stocks in Singapore was reflected in data released by the Trade Development Board which showed that middle distillate stocks have risen by 993,000 barrels to 11.236 million barrels for the week ending June 11.
Stocks in Hong Kong were also high, limiting the outlets for the excess cargoes in the region.
Sporadic demand was seen from China but traders said it was insufficient to absorb the surplus barrels.

Vietnam has also emerged to buy three cargoes of gas oil for power generation use. The 1.0 percent sulphur diesel were sold at about 70 cents premium over spot Singapore quotes on a cost and freight basis Ho Chin Minh City.

The weak market was reflected in the award of Sri Lanka's buy tender for late June deliveries. 250,000 barrels of gas oil and 50,000 barrels of jet were sold by Vitol at discounts of 11.5 cents and 6.5 cents respectively under spot Singapore quotes. This is lower than the previous award at 10-cents premia.
